title: Beyond the Dark Portal
summary: After the Second War, the Alliance crosses into Draenor while Ner'zhul's portal ritual tears the world toward Outland.
opening: Victory on Azeroth did not end the danger beyond the portal. An expedition followed it home to a world already nearing ruin.

chapters.title: After the Second War
chapters.body: Set out the defeated Horde's position and the surviving link between Azeroth and Draenor. The chapter boundary is an editorial placement for a story that begins after the Second War.

chapters.title: Ner'zhul seeks new worlds
chapters.body: Trace the attempt to open further portals from Draenor and the threat this creates for both worlds. The original game and book text must settle the ritual's steps.

chapters.title: The Alliance expedition
chapters.body: Follow the Alliance forces that cross the Dark Portal to stop the plan. Each theater needs its own source review rather than an invented route between worlds.

chapters.title: Draenor breaks
chapters.body: The portal ritual leaves Draenor shattered. Close on the survivors and the changed world that later histories call Outland, using separate map states for before and after.

reviewNote: Era 6 to Era 7 placement remains an editorial boundary choice. Cross-check the Spanish timeline lead with original English game and book sources; keep Draenor and Outland geographically separate.
